headline: Mooring County Tilts Further Colonial as Stlican Shelf Stirs
war_summary: Since our last edition the storm has shifted ground without spending itself. Mooring County has cost the Wardens a further post, the county now standing eight Warden to three Colonial with one work in ruin; sixty-three base actions were counted in the day, Gravekeeper's Holdfast the stormiest of them, and two-hour casualty returns topping two thousand are only now beginning to cool. In the Weathered Expanse the Colonials have lost a holding to no-man's-land, leaving five posts against one Warden and three demolished; Wightwalk drew thirty-seven of the day's eighty-one actions, and Warden losses remain the heavier. Olavis Wake's brief blaze has died, the Wardens holding all five posts once more. Marban Hollow has gone quiet since Checkpoint Bua's late pounding. The Nevish Line keeps its seven-to-one footing under steady but slackening fire, and Callahan's Passage stirred briefly before hushing again. Fresh trouble shows in Stlican Shelf, where actions were logged shortly before this edition closed. Day 559; thirty-four victory towns are demanded, and no victor is named.
